facts.statement: Community Event 'Harvest Picnic Party' was held on Server 1 with an outdoor feast, games and dancing, run by the Ambassadors.
facts.quote: Come join the Ambassadors for an outdoor feast, fun games and lots of dancing!

facts.statement: The Harvest Picnic Party had a Thursday session on November 17, 2011 at 3:00 P.M. US Pacific Time on Server 1.
facts.quote: Thursday, November 17th, 2011 3:00 P.M. (US Pacific Time) Server 1

facts.statement: The Harvest Picnic Party had a Friday session on November 18, 2011 at 9:30 A.M. US Pacific Time on Server 1.
facts.quote: Friday, November 18th, 2011 9:30 A.M. (US Pacific Time) Server 1

article_summaries.title: Community Event: Harvest Picnic Party
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language freerealms.com news page announcing the Community Event 'Harvest Picnic Party', an in-game Thanksgiving-season gathering run by the Ambassadors with a feast, games and dancing. It gives two Server 1 showtimes (November 17 and 18, 2011) and says players join via the GO button on the in-game Activity Calendar or by adding the Ambassador Events character to friends. The page was captured in March 2012, after the event.
